name: K-27
description: K-27 was a green-plated Protocol droid with masculine programming who worked on the planet Kashyyyk. K-27 arrived with Turren Lonarr, president of the Temporary Droids rental service, which had a local office on the planet. He spoke Basic and Shyriiwook fluently, as well as the less-common Xaczik language of the Wartaki Islands.
